manifestChangelog: 2026-09-03 release: ferryman 1.3.0 (push.py was sending a `source` key the import schema rejects 422, so every 1.2.0 push failed at validate -- removed; --participants ships as a frontmatter YAML list; --base flag; runbook example corrected; participants matrix row LIVE). 2026-08-28 release: ferryman 1.2.0 (PATCH correction path, API catalog, owner rules, Topics trap, participants gap documented), transcript-processor 1.2.1 (owner rules + corrected push facts + verbatim check), people-adapter 1.0.1 (career-arc facet), shell v0.2 (standing reminders folded into current-focus, dispatcher-cursor dropped, Ferret reference removed). v2 (2026-07-28): per-skill files[] mappings (src in this repo -> dest in a brain) so the assembler can build a new brain straight from the registry; shell component versioned; update-skill + ferryman-adapter-contract now bundled. All v1 fields unchanged — /update keeps working.

shell.changelog: v0.2 (2026-08-28): standing reminders live in the 📌 section of context/current-focus.md (standing-reminders.md dropped); dispatcher-cursor.md dropped (a dispatcher install creates its own); Ferret removed from the sync-adapter list; 4-state-file pattern documented in context/readme.md. v0.1: structure default (folder skeleton + per-folder readmes + SETUP/SHELL/WHAT-YOU-GET + CLAUDE.md with {{INHABITANT}} placeholders), cast 2026-07-09.
shell.source: local:brain-shell (resolved by assemble-brain.py on the maintainer machine; informational only)
shell.note: Assembler clones this, then installs the skills below. Versioned here so structure updates can propagate like skill updates. Phase 2: host the shell + serve via GET /api/v1/pack.

skills.changelog: Closed-pool OWNER RULES (presets fixed app-side 2026-08-25 — no more parity exception) + corrected token capabilities (PATCH fixes metadata; delete doesn't exist) + Pending-Review-on-the-record wording + Topics bullet-format trap + verbatim-vs-notes export check.
skills.blurb: processes your meeting/mentor-call transcripts into app-matching summaries + action items (preset parity); answers questions about transcripts; surfaces prompts discussed in calls; runs the mandatory People fold into `people/` cards after every transcript.

skills.changelog: REQUIRED FIX: push.py sent `source: manual`, which the import schema rejects 422 (Unrecognized field), so every 1.2.0 markdown push failed at validate with no visible error -- key removed from both payload builders. NEW: --participants "Full Name,Full Name" writes a participants YAML list into the frontmatter (a top-level key is rejected the same way); participants only, never mentions; read the import response's contacts block (ambiguous = linked to nobody). NEW: --base (retarget API base). Reminder: --title (existing) overrides the H1-derived title. Runbook step-4 example corrected; rules matrix participants row LIVE. pull.py / pipeline-verify.py / adapter contract unchanged.
skills.blurb: sync between your PF App account (your own personal token) and your local app mirror. PULL/STATUS via `pull.py`; PUSH is LIVE via `push.py --push-summary` (validate-first, upsert-by-id); `pipeline-verify.py` checks the invariants. Intake procedure: [[skills/ferryman/transcript-intake-runbook.md]].

skills.changelog: Facet registry v2: career-arc joins the base facets (optional, senior/partner/mentor cards mainly). people.py unchanged.
skills.blurb: the machine door to `people/` cards — `people.py --list` (frontmatter facets), `--get <slug>` (shareable/full tiers, [private] always stripped), `--verify` (schema + fold checks against `people/facets.json`). People cards NEVER push to the app — brain-side only.
